finalText:
I made the headline one step bigger on four of the five artboards. The fifth, **D · Team hub**, is unchanged because another AI run was working on it.

- **Changed:** Welcome, GitHub door, Local folder and You're in. Each headline went from 34px to about 41px, with slightly tighter line spacing to match.
- **New step:** 34px is already the largest size in the maude design system, so there's no next step to use. I added one on this canvas only, at 1.2 times the top size. That follows the system's own ratio between sizes, and the design system itself is untouched.
- **Team hub:** this headline uses the same style as the others. To keep the change off the busy artboard, I didn't change that shared style. Instead I added a new style, `ob-h1--up`, and put it on the four free headlines only. When the other run finishes, add that style to the Team hub headline in `.design/ui/Onboarding.tsx:250` and it will match.

The canvas check passed. I looked at a screenshot of each changed artboard: every headline still fits on one line and nothing overlaps. The screenshots came out small, so that's a check of layout, not fine detail.
